project.name: elevenlabs
project.description:
ElevenLabs voice cloning integration - Master-Roadmap-2026.md item #4. New sibling module, same shape as "sarvam": a tenant BYOK ElevenLabs API key (own credential table, not reused from LlmProviderCredential - unlike imagegen's OpenAI reuse, ElevenLabs has no other reason to already have a row there), voice cloning (upload a short sample clip, ElevenLabs returns a voice_id), and text-to-speech synthesis against a cloned voice.
Unlike Sarvam/imagegen, voice cloning cannot be a pure "reuse an existing credential, wire a tool" feature - the clone step itself needs a real setup action (upload an audio sample) that only makes sense as a direct API call, not an agent tool call (a tool result is text-in/text-out; a multipart audio upload has no natural place in that shape). So this module exposes two REST surfaces: /api/elevenlabs/credential (BYOK activation, mirrors SarvamController) and /api/elevenlabs/voices (clone/ list/delete, a real setup action akin to connecting a channel). Only synthesis (given an already-cloned voice_id) becomes the agent tool - ElevenLabsSpeakToolCallback in core/agents, mirroring SarvamSpeakToolCallback.
Depends on: crypto (EncryptionService for the stored key), security (TenantContext parity with every sibling module in this position), tenancy (schema-per-tenant isolation - no tenant_id column needed on any table here, same as SarvamCredential/GeneratedImage), storage (FileStorageService - synthesized MP3 clips are stored the same way SarvamGeneratedAudio/GeneratedImage bytes are, never inline in a tool result).
